claims.text: Response behavior in alcohol self-reports is influenced by the interaction of social context factors, respondent characteristics, and task attributes.
Self-report methods offer a reliable approach to measuring alcohol consumption.
Self-report methods offer a valid approach to measuring alcohol consumption.

evidence.description: Response behavior is influenced by the interaction of social context factors, respondent characteristics, and task attributes.
Self-report methods offer a reliable and valid approach to measuring alcohol consumption.
Self-report methods offer a reliable and valid approach to measuring alcohol consumption.

methodologies.name: Literature Review
methodologies.description: A review of factors influencing response accuracy, relative merits of self-report approaches, and the utility of alternative confirmatory measures in alcohol self-reports.

limitations.text: Many questions remain unanswered regarding how task demands interact with different drinking patterns to affect response accuracy.

future_work.text: Investigate how task demands interact with different patterns of drinking behavior to affect response accuracy.
Use multiple data sources to examine the extent of self-report response bias and determine whether it varies as a function of respondent characteristics or assessment timing.
Conduct research directed at understanding the cognitive processes involved in response behavior to improve accuracy.
